written.title: GTA 6 Cars Appear in Real Life as Part of Insane Miami Marketing Push
written.description: What IGN, Rock Paper Shotgun, GamesRadar+ and Push Square reported about Vice City on 13 October 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Vice City, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## IGN, 13 October 2026

['I Feel Really Uncomfortable With This Whole Thing' — Miami Officials Express Concern Over Rockstar's GTA 6 Takeover](https://www.ign.com/articles/rockstars-multi-million-dollar-miami-takeover-continues-to-expand-ahead-of-gta-6-launch-despite-protests-from-some-officials)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar Games is continuing to ramp up GTA 6's massive marketing with a Vice City blimp, NFL promos, and much more, despite protests from Miami officials.

> By Cade Onder Updated : Oct 13, 2026 3:04pm UTC 11 comments Add IGN on Google Rockstar Games is continuing to ramp up GTA 6's massive marketing with a Vice City blimp, NFL promos, and much more, despite protests from some Miami officials.

> GTA 6 takes place in a fictional version of Miami known as Vice City, so Rockstar is utilizing the city for a lot of its advertising, which has led to friction between city officials.

> In September, Rockstar paid just shy of $1 million to install a massive, glowing "Welcome to Vice City" sign on top of the Miami Heat's arena, the Kaseya Center .

> On November 18, the Miami Heat will play a regular season game against the Milwaukee Bucks on a Vice City-themed court with never-before-seen jerseys inspired by GTA 6 .

> The arena will also be selling Vice City merch, with Rockstar and the NBA labeling the event as a "night in Vice City." GTA 6 Reveal: 15 New Screenshots, Including 1 Exclusive on IGN View 15 Images Over the weekend, Miami's Hard Rock Stadium, the home of the Miami Dolphins, was covered in GTA 6 ads.

> A Goodyear blimp with Vice City branding is currently flying out of Ohio and is reportedly on its way to North Carolina.

> Rockstar has also put up at least one Vice City mural in Miami.

> It's clear Rockstar is ready to spend whatever it takes to get the word out and to effectively turn Miami into a real version of Vice City.

> Goodyear Blimp with Vice City livery is currently flying south out of Akron, Ohio.

## Rock Paper Shotgun, 13 October 2026

[GTA 6 PC release planned for early 2027, report claims, which could mean we're playing in time for GTA Online 2: Vice City 4 U or whatever they call it](https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/gta-6-pc-release-planned-for-early-2027-report-claims-which-could-mean-were-playing-in-time-for-gta-online-2-vice-city-4-u-or-whatever-they-call-it)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6's PC release is being planned for early 2027 by Rockstar, a new report claims.

> On the other hand, you've got sceptics like RPS boss Jules, who saw this report and was firm in his stance that he won't believe GTA 6 is turning up on his machine in such short order until protagonist Jason's naked body is right there on his monitor, rendered in all of the glory only a PC could manage.

> GTA 6 PC release planned for early 2027, report claims, which could mean we're playing in time for GTA Online 2: Vice City 4 U or whatever they call it Luci-ya sooner than expected Image credit: Rockstar Games News by Mark Warren Senior Staff Writer Published on Oct.

## GamesRadar+, 16 October 2026

[Rockstar's figured out the perfect GTA 6 advertisement - a bunch of supercars from Vice City speeding along the streets of Miami](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/rockstars-figured-out-the-perfect-gta-6-advertisement-a-bunch-of-supercars-from-vice-city-speeding-along-the-streets-of-miami/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Because why not

> A separate thread confirms as much, with the cars seen driving around Florida, led by a Vice City Police Department car.

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 Rockstar's figured out the perfect GTA 6 advertisement - a bunch of supercars from Vice City speeding along the streets of Miami News By Anna Koselke Published 16 October 2026 Because why not When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission.

> There's just something about seeing all the fleshed out, patterned GTA 6 cars cruisin' around real-life Vice City that you can't beat, I suppose, and I'm clearly not alone in thinking so.

> There's a Manana, Buccaneer, Tempesta, Cheetah, Coquette D10, and Emerus, as the fan behind the video posts.

## IGN, 16 October 2026

[Rockstar Drives Real GTA 6 Cars Through Miami, Including Lambo Police Cruiser With Leonida Plates](https://www.ign.com/articles/rockstar-mods-real-life-vehicles-gta-6-cars-miami)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar’s wild marketing push for GTA 6 is well underway, with the latest seeing modded cars cruising around Miami.

> Other looks included real-life takes on the Cheetah, the Coquette D10, the Tempesta, and the Manana.

## Push Square, 16 October 2026

[GTA 6 Cars Appear in Real Life as Part of Insane Miami Marketing Push](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/10/gta-6-cars-appear-in-real-life-as-part-of-insane-miami-marketing-push)

The outlet's own summary:

> Vice City is real now

> Among them are police cars from the Vice Beach Police Department.

> Vice City-themed vehicles have been spotted in Miami, including a Lamborghini in Vice Beach PD livery.

> The Leonida plates match those seen in the earlier Suzuki tease. #GTAVI 📸 @/gianni_mariotti & @/andrewblakeames (Instagram) pic.twitter.com/hZVGzjPNaF - iGrandTheftAuto.com (@iGrandTheftAuto) October 16, 2026 In the above videos, numerous real life vehicles have been kitted out to look like cars from GTA 6, with Vice City number plates and colourful body kits.

> Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA GTA 6 Cars Appear in Real Life as Part of Insane Miami Marketing Push Vice City is real now by Stephen Tailby 8 hours ago Share: It was obvious already, but with an outrageous marketing push behind it, GTA 6 is clearly going to be absolutely massive when it arrives next month.

> The hotly anticipated open world action game is scheduled for 19th November, 2026, and Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two are going all-out with a marketing campaign that's overtaking Miami, Florida, gradually turning it into a real-life Vice City.

> We've already heard about a one-night-only basketball match, in which the team Miami Heat will be rebranded as Vice City , playing against Milwaukee in a special promotional game.

> On top of that, clips seen on Instagram show Vice City branding being installed, a blimp bearing the logo, and planes flying promotional banners.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
